record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo (Helioptile 1 star, Heliolisk 2 stars) declare PARABOLIC_CHARGE and both carry the passive DRY_SKIN in the catalog. Shared strategy. DRY_SKIN is a separate weather-driven periodic effect (see unresolved) and is not part of this ability.
record.summary: Heals the caster, then deals SPECIAL damage to the cast target. Heal request: 25 (1 star) / 50 (2 stars) raw (75 / 100 at 3 / 4+ stars, not reachable here), with no AP or crit scaling. Damage raw: 25 (1 star) / 50 (2 stars) (100 / 200 at 3 / 4+) PLUS overHeal, where overHeal = max(0, requestedHeal + caster.hp - caster.maxHP) is computed BEFORE the heal from the caster's current HP and the UNMODIFIED requested heal. It therefore measures how much of the requested heal would exceed missing HP; it is not the overheal that handleHeal reports after its modifiers. The heal is requested first, the damage second, in the same call; the damage reads the overHeal value computed earlier, not the caster's HP after healing. Illustration only (arithmetic, not a fight): Heliolisk (heal 50) at 90/100 HP: pre-heal overHeal 40, damage raw 50 + 40 = 90 before AP and the target's speDef; with no heal modifiers handleHeal's own overheal is also 40 (healed 10), so a Grass Heliolisk would request addMaxHP(16) - but with, say, burning (x0.5) handleHeal would heal 25 capped to 10 and report overheal 15 while the damage still uses 40. The heal itself follows handleHeal's branches: a wounded caster gets no HP (Blood Moon + Blood Stone can request an addShield instead), an unwounded caster with status.protect gets nothing (Rune Protect alone does not block), and Grass overheal requests addMaxHP(0.4 x overheal).

targeting.who: heal: the caster itself; damage: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

effects.scaling: apBoost 0 and crit false are passed, so neither AP nor crit scales the heal
effects.resolution: requested heal = raw. Applied: PokemonState.handleHeal: a wounded caster receives 0 (Blood Moon weather plus Blood Stone can request a shield of round(0.3 x stones x heal) instead); an unwounded caster at 0 hp or with status.protect gets nothing (status.runeProtect is not read; a wounded caster has already taken the wound branch); otherwise x1.3 BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burn, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 ZENITH weather are applied, the result is rounded and capped at missing HP; the rounded excess over missing HP (handleHeal's own overheal, measured after the modifiers) on a unit with the GRASS synergy effect requests addMaxHP(0.4 x that overheal) on the caster, which also raises its current HP. The requested heal and the applied change differ; the overHeal used for the damage is the pre-heal raw value max(0, heal + hp - maxHP) computed from the UNMODIFIED request and the pre-heal HP (kept unchanged), not handleHeal's result or the Grass amount. The direct heal path calls no stat adder, but the indirect branches of handleHeal do: the Blood Moon + Blood Stone shield request goes through the entity addShield (Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down, then the state's addShield: hp > 0, enraged halves, rounded) and the Grass request goes through addMaxHP (rounded, Big Eater Belt, Twist Band, raises maxHP and current HP). Those downstream requests are not the final shield / max HP when an item helper applies (probe: shield request 6 -> final 7 with Big Eater Belt; Grass request 16 -> final 20).

effects.extraTerm: overHeal = max(0, requestedHeal + caster.hp - caster.maxHP), computed before the heal
effects.scaling: requested amount = table + overHeal, then AP: x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true); a cast crit multiplies by critPower reduced by the target's critReductionFactor (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: applied: handleDamage divides by (1 + 0.05 x speDef) with speDef halved if the target has armor reduction active, ceil, minimum 1, shield first; takenDamage is not used by this ability. Blocked (0) by protect / skydiving / magicBounce (magicBounce may reflect SPECIAL damage unless the caster holds Protective Pads) and for a dead or resurrecting target; the heal is not undone when the damage is blocked.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the caster's stars; the 3 and 4 star values (heal 75 / 100, damage 100 / 200) are not reachable by the two listed units. maxPP 80 and range 3 for both.

passiveNote.note: declared by both units; separate from this ability. In RAIN or DROUGHT weather it adds a periodic effect (RAIN: caster heal 8; DROUGHT: 8 TRUE damage to itself); SANDSTORM adds 0.25 dodge chance and ZENITH adds 50 AP on spawn. Not traced further.

record.positionalConditions: None read beyond needing a target (range 3 for both units).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast recomputes overHeal from the caster's current HP.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: heal 25 / 50 (labelled requested), damage base 25 / 50 plus overHeal. Applied heal passes the handleHeal modifiers (wound, buffs, burn, enraged, weather, cap at missing HP) and is not what overHeal is built from. Damage dealt = (base + overHeal) x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then speDef division (ceil, at least 1). A wounded or burning caster still gets the full overHeal bonus on the damage (the pre-heal raw overHeal is not changed by handleHeal's wound, protect or modifier branches). Indirect healing branches (Blood Stone addShield, Grass addMaxHP) are requests whose final values depend on the item helpers; see effects[0].
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Shield, Cover Band, Fossil and resurrection branches of handleDamage were not traced here (takenDamage is unused by PARABOLIC_CHARGE); consulted core-mechanics.md section A and the speDef step only

The heal side was read in handleHeal (wound, alive/protect gate, modifiers, rounding, cap, GRASS overheal); the Blood Moon shield branch and the Grass branch call addShield / addMaxHP; their item helpers were read here (core-mechanics.md section J, probe SHARED_HELPERS), but weather and Blood Stone ownership in real fights were not
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence): only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read
unresolved: DRY_SKIN (declared by both units) is a separate periodic or spawn effect tied to the weather (RAIN heal 8, DROUGHT 8 TRUE self-damage, SANDSTORM dodge, ZENITH AP); it was read only far enough to confirm it does not call this ability's code, and its interaction with the ability was not further traced
Whether Heliolisk or Helioptile get the GRASS synergy effect in practice depends on team composition; not determined
No other unit sharing the identifier exists in the queue; units not listed are not covered
Mechanical checks only; no probe was run and no fight observed

Probe SHARED_HELPERS (pinned handleHeal / addShield / addMaxHP text on stub units, apBoost 0): Protect -> 0 healed, Rune Protect alone -> healed; wound + Protect + Blood Moon + one Blood Stone, heal 20 -> addShield request 6, no HP; Grass 990/1000, heal 50 -> healed 10, overheal 40, addMaxHP request 16. Helper requests and results only; the PARABOLIC_CHARGE damage step was not re-executed and the pre-heal overHeal arithmetic is source reading.
